desc: One piece Over The Barrel (OTB) adapter for ops inc 12th model, AEM5 and OCM5. Made from H900 heat treated 17-4 steel this one piece adapter will allow you to mount your silencer to any barrel with 1/2×28 threads that is .75 OD or less with a minimum of 2.95-3 inches of exposed barrel. Made with integrated wrench flats in the rear for easy installation or removal with any adjustable crescent wrench.
